content: Vanakkam Arun! Saw that you also moved from Tenkasi to Gurugram. Are you working in Cyber City?
Vanakkam Priya! Yes, I joined an engineering team at DLF Cyber City Building 10. How long have you been in Gurugram?
About 7 months now! Still getting used to the winter weather, but finding Tamil folks nearby has made it so much better.
Hey Arun! Are you up for tennis-ball cricket this Sunday at Sector 29? We have a fun group playing every weekend.
